commitments.detail: The quilt will be displayed at the local museum for six months starting October 1, 2023, and then returned to the family.
A formal agreement will be signed between the family and the local museum ensuring the quilt's safekeeping during the exhibition period.
The granddaughter will be provided with detailed care instructions to ensure the quilt remains in good condition after the display period.
The quilt will be on permanent loan to the local museum for a period of three months, starting June 1, 2023.
After the display period, the quilt will be handed over to the great-aunt's granddaughter for safekeeping.
A formal loan agreement will be signed between the family and the local museum for the display period.
